topic: Data extraction timeline and file format
summary_markdown:
The discussion covered two main points: the data extraction task (DOOH-1403) and the required file format for OTFD data.

Regarding DOOH-1403, [p1] suggested running the extraction procedure in a low-stress environment, such as September 2024. This would allow verification of the process before committing to copying the full October data set or later periods near the deadline (mid-November).

For the OTFD data format, it was confirmed that Parquet files are acceptable.
decisions: The DOOH-1403 extraction procedure will be tested using September 2024 data.
Parquet file format is approved for OTFD data.
action_items: Test the DOOH-1403 extraction process using September 2024 data.
